blocks.text: SIGNIFICANT EVENTS FORTHCOMING - The world is quickly moving into a global business and unit. Time is shortening. These following important Scriptures will appear on the earth soon. — | Thess. 4:17, ‘Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.” Acts 1:11, “This same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.” | Cor.15:51,52, “Behold, | shew you a mystery; we shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed. In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.” Without a doubt God gives us the difference between the Translation and the end of Tribulation appearance!

In Zech. 14:3-4 it says, “Then shall the Lord go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle. And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south. “Verse 5”...And the Lord my God shall come, and all the saints with thee.”

But in Thessalonians it says we meet Him in the air, and Zechariah says after the Tribulation He puts his foot down upon the earth — the mount of Olives. Rev. 19:14, “And the armies which were in Heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.” Rev.10:4-6, “And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, | was about to write: and | heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not. And the angel which | saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven. And sware by him that liveth forever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer.”

Hag.2:6-7, “For thus saith the Lord of hosts; Yet once, it is a little while, and | will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land; And | will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and | will fill this house with glory, saith the Lord of hosts.” — This we see beginning already partially according to scientists too. More will increase. Rev.17: 1-5. — The first part of this is tising subtly over the world and U.S.A., and will rule with the United States. Also Rev. 3:17, “Because thou sayest, | am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing: and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked,” will come into complete power in a period ahead. Rev. 18, commercial Babylon is already operating, reaching it’s height during the Tribulation.

Deut. 30:4, “If any of thine be driven out into the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the Lord thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee.” He reveals way back in the beginning how that men would go way out into space, but he would bring them back. This gives to us and looks like a double prophecy of what they are doing now and later in the Millennium as the next Scripture confirms. — Obad. 1:4. (Listen to this.) He said, “exalt thyself as the eagle.” That was the craft that landed on the Moon. But the next one has further portent. “And though thou set thy nest among the stars.” Setting their nest is out of our galaxy, which reminds us of the Millennium knowledge. (Dan.12:4) “Many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.” — Also the knowledge of the Lord shall cover the earth as the waters cover the sea! Yet already men have an international space station that they live in like a nest.

These Scriptures are appearing now partially and also these others: Luke 21:25-26, “And there shall be signs in the sun, and in moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring; Men’s hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.”’Here we see revealing weather patterns. Also the sun is acting up bringing sudden changes. People and science are perplexed. It mentions the powers of the heavens shaken — mainly by atomic and solar activity.

ISRAEL PROPHECY -— The Scriptures say it will be a trembling cup and trouble to all nations. And it is definitely so (now year 2000). As | said, after many pitfalls they will receive the covenant (Dan. 9;26- 27). — Note: At this date Nov. 20, 2000 Israel fired missiles at the shores of the Mediterranean Gaza Strip. Moreso later at Armageddon — the Mediterranean will be on fire.

PROPHETIC INVENTIONS— Radio, including T.V. and internet, computers, telephone — Job 38:35, “Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?” It also involves the micro-chip. Rev. 13:11-16 shows the same thing, making fire and electric, signs and wonders — and mentions the ‘image’. It will be seen over television. It also explains the electronic age, where it comes from, giving the ‘mark’. The word ‘in’ the forehead — something is put in the forehead and in the hand. Matt. 25:10, “And while they went to buy, the bride groom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.” The door — midnight cry — foolish ones went to the door — it was closed. The ark door is still open — body of Christ. But soon God will shut it. Rev.4:1-3 shows where we’re caught up before the Throne. — Same in Matthew 25 where He closes the door after the midnight cry is given by the Elect. It mentions “go ye out”. It means — to get out of any system that does not believe in His soon return or full word! = — Rev. 3:15 — He is knocking for the last time!

THE RETURN -— Events will move swiftly and they are now. It says He will come as a flash of lightening-suddenly-unexpectedly. The Elect will know by the signs and prophecy of His word. And in the book of Revelation before it closes it repeats three times. “Behold | come quickly,” revealing unexpected, in an hour ye think not!

VITAL FORTHCOMING EVENTS - U.S.A.— Washington, D.C. in the next few years will be haunted by the unexpected and surprises, plus mysterious occurances. Then it turns into a nightmare. (Note: By the way, this was written before the Election crises — also read Sept. 2000 letter.) Later the Vatican will be controlled differently. Instead of the Pope saying he is the Vicar (in place of God), a religious leader will come and say he is God incarnate. — At this time Israel will welcome a false Messiah. Before this, events, phantasm, sorcery, illusion, magic-like fantasy will overwhelm the masses. A subtle snare will overcome the churches and world. — The age of the dragon. Satan will draw people’s attention. They will be caught up in all of this! The electronic and wireless wizardry, cell phone, will control the minds and soul of the people completely.

CONTINUING— The dark angel will cast the shadow of death over America and the world. — Like God did in Egypt; even blackened it out for a spell (Rev. 16:10). All because they rejected Jesus the light of the world. — Worldwide events are casting their shadows; electrifying occurrences and portents of evil and future desolation. — For instance, concerning the weather, it rained 36 inches in Hawaii in one day (Nov. 2nd). And a rare tornado hit south of London, England (end of Oct. 2000). Indeed, the news said, unusual! We could quote dozens of other events that occurred in just the last few months.
The elect churchage is ending. Earth shaking events will appear fulfilling climatic prophecies, unique occurances.
